speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Milk Jaundice

The indirect bilirubin of 6.4 mg/dL is predominantly unconjugated, the Coombs test is negative, and your stools are not pale, which effectively rules out hemolysis and biliary atresia. Given the exclusive breastfeeding history and the timing of symptom onset, this is consistent with breast milk jaundice.
